notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: One health system. Many locations. One explainable pipeline.
intro: A proposed revenue-operations workbench for Verse Medical: map health-system relationships, resolve commercial ownership and inspect the evidence behind pipeline movement.
queueIntro: All health systems, locations and commercial opportunities are fictional. No patient, medical-order, coverage or clinical data is used.
workbenchIntro: Review entity relationships, stage evidence and forecast timing. This is a commercial pipeline model, not a patient referral or equipment-eligibility workflow.
firstBody: Connect health-system and location records to ownership, stage evidence and an explicit reason for every forecast change.

fields.label: Health system, location and business source mapped
Territory and current account ownership reconciled
Opportunity stage has supporting business evidence
Close date and next activity reviewed
Pipeline source and influence recorded separately
Commercial record excludes patient or order data

rules.title: Resolve the health-system hierarchy
rules.next: One health system can contain many locations and business referral sources. Keep those relationships distinct.

rules.title: Resolve the territory conflict
rules.next: Preserve the health-system relationship while assigning the location’s appropriate commercial owner.

rules.title: Validate the opportunity stage
rules.next: Record the commercial milestone and next step before advancing the opportunity.

rules.title: Review the forecast timing
rules.next: An old close date without a next step needs an owner’s review, not an automatic roll-forward.

rules.title: Reconcile pipeline attribution
rules.next: A location-level source may contribute to a system-level deal. Preserve both without double counting revenue.

rules.title: Keep the pipeline record commercial
rules.next: Use organizational buying context, not patient records, medical necessity or equipment-order details.

ready.title: Ready for a commercial pipeline review
ready.next: The account and forecast owners can inspect the relationship, stage evidence and next action. Forecast movement should remain distinct from revenue actuals.

experiments.name: Location-aware ownership review
experiments.hypothesis: Explicit health-system relationships reduce duplicate opportunities.
experiments.guardrail: Double-counted pipeline and lost parent relationships
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: Evidence in pipeline reviews
experiments.hypothesis: A specific next step and movement reason improve forecast discussions.
experiments.primary: Opportunities with a supported next action
experiments.guardrail: Automatic date roll-forward and invented explanations
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Map the commercial entities and definitions
roadmap.body: Work with RevOps and Sales on health-system, location and source relationships. Agree on stage and forecast definitions.

roadmap.title: Build an inspectable pipeline view
roadmap.body: Add ownership checks, stale-date exceptions and a movement ledger that preserves the original snapshot.
roadmap.measure: Owned exceptions and explained forecast movement

roadmap.title: Connect reporting to operating action
roadmap.body: Turn recurring review questions into tested workflows and concise account briefs. Keep Finance and Sales on the same definitions.
roadmap.measure: Pipeline hygiene, follow-up completion and forecast explainability

metricsTitle: Reconcile the forecast before explaining it.
metricsIntro: A synthetic forecast bridge separates new opportunities, amount changes and timing movement.
metricsNotes: All values are invented commercial examples, not Verse Medical results.
Opening 500,000 + new 120,000 − adjustments 20,000 − pushed 90,000 − lost 30,000 = closing 480,000.
Pipeline, forecast, bookings, collected revenue and commission credit require separate definitions.
